figure_model: final P0-4 numerical-reference model for all driven panels

fixed_inputs.pulse_provenance: selected by scripts/optimize_forster_p0_4_reference.py on the final P0-4 numerical-reference model
fixed_inputs.reoptimization_status: deterministic accepted local candidate; 400-iteration / 625-evaluation budget exhausted; not a converged or global optimum

assumptions.metric: zero-T no-jump loss-aware average overlap, not CPTP process fidelity
assumptions.response_local_z: nominal recalibration per assumed response time
assumptions.position_and_amplitude_local_z: fixed final-reference nominal 3.10 G / 10 ns correction
assumptions.magnetic_local_z: both fixed-3.10-G and per-field nominal recalibration stored; plotted curve recalibrates
assumptions.magnetic_carriers: both species track local isolated-atom transitions, not a fixed-laser noise prediction
assumptions.trajectory: conditional branch initialization at start of filtered Yb target window; no jump branches
assumptions.robustness: sampled finite-basis evidence, not a certified continuous minimum or complete laboratory error budget
assumptions.angular_scope: retained Delta-M=0 block; omitted nonzero Delta-M couplings at transverse offsets

stage_1.varied_parameters: six amplitudes/detunings at fixed common segment duration
stage_1.message: Maximum number of iterations has been exceeded.

pulse_selection.stopping_condition: stage 1 reached its recorded optimizer termination; exact validation then crossed nominal 0.999, so stage 2 was not triggered

axial_position_scan.source: exact P1-1 retained-block radial nodes, not interpolated response surface

historical_scan_basis_diagnostics.scope: Historical SCAN_BASIS diagnostics, not current Fig. 3 data

assumptions.aom_model: independent first-order field-amplitude and detuning response
assumptions.rb_excitation: effective two-level 5 MHz pi pulse; intermediate-state scattering omitted
assumptions.decay: zero-temperature lifetime-weighted non-Hermitian no-jump attenuation; state-resolved jump branches are not modeled
assumptions.local_z: one correction calibrated at the nominal point and held fixed
assumptions.rb_hyperfine: I=3/2; A I.J plus electric-quadrupole term and nuclear Zeeman; all mI retained in the exact M_tot=5/2 block
assumptions.transverse_geometry: angle-dependent Delta-M=0 dipole tensor retained; Delta-M=+/-1,+/-2 terms omitted for the <=0.85 degree sampled tilts

transverse_delta_m_control.comparison: same electronic-only pulse validation with full angular coupling versus the Delta-M=0 projection over the 19 stored geometries

optimization.note: selected final-reference pulse evaluated without further refinement; all outputs from this script are SCAN_BASIS diagnostics

selected_pulse_provenance.method: bounded adaptive Nelder-Mead local refinement at fixed duration
selected_pulse_provenance.objective: max(1-F) + 0.02*mean(1-F) over 8 training vertices plus nominal
selected_pulse_provenance.selection_status: deterministic accepted local candidate; not a converged or global optimum

optimization.optional_optimize_behavior: --optimize runs the historical SCAN_BASIS local diagnostic refinement starting from SELECTED_PARAMETERS; it does not reproduce pulse selection

omitted_f_state_stress_test.note: stress test, not a measured F-state normalization; uses the largest fitted low-l A and B prefactors

quasi_random_validation.construction: 32-point deterministic unscrambled Sobol sequence mapped to radius r=50 nm*u^(1/3) and direction cosine 2v-1; space-filling validation only, not a thermal probability distribution

target_pair_defect_scan.definition: offset added to E_SS-E_PP by shifting the target PP projector while holding the optically addressed SS asymptote and pulse fixed
target_pair_defect_scan.scope: effective target-pair sensitivity scan, not correlated atomic-structure uncertainty propagation

axial_dc_electric_field_scan.definition: parallel dc field applied to the finite pair Hamiltonian with the same pulse command; optical carriers remain defined relative to the field-shifted isolated SS transition
axial_dc_electric_field_scan.scope: pair-Hamiltonian and fixed-local-Z sensitivity, not a full fixed-laser laboratory calibration or arbitrary field-direction scan

nominal_metric_decomposition.conditional_definition: loss-aware average overlap divided by mean computational survival; a postselected no-jump diagnostic, not a CPTP channel fidelity
